title: Vcs Backbone Actor Invariant Everywhere
description: Guarantee the vcs architecture invariant across every playground, app, and OS surface, and migrate Compose/Sketchpad onto it: every document is always a DocumentVcsStore (in-memory edit log + checkpoint DAG + causal OpDag, materialized by replay); the backbone is a non-blocking, IO-free, runtime-attachable/detachable queue (default: no backbone attached); all IO lives in a per-document sync actor with bidirectional communication (command channel in, event broadcast out, crossed queues). Close all gaps identified in exploration (register_app escape hatch, TS/Rust dual sync-actor implementations, deprecated attachSyncBackbone, Ack/presence half-wired, wgpu browser attach stub, os/run bypassing the folder backbone, StudioVcsHost not backbone-attachable, auto_attach_backbone violating default-detached on wasm). Migrate Compose/Sketchpad's parallel persistence stack (hand-rolled VCS entity model, bespoke kit-backbone, compose-store server, compose hub) onto vcs + backbone, deleting the parallel axes and the os-core legacy shim outright. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-sure-vcs-always-witty-wilkes.md.
